title: Gimle earn BLNO title
description: Baerum Basket - Gimle BBK 74-76 Gimle BBK claimed the BLNO title. They nipped Baerum Basket on the road in Game 4 to lift the trophy. Strangely Baerum Basket outrebounded Gimle BBK 45-31 including 35 on the defensive glass. Worth to mention a great performance of Serbian-Montenegrin center Milovan Savic (205-1987) who helped to win the game recording 19 points and 8 rebounds and the former international guard Mikkel Kolstad (193-1995, college: Nova SE) who added 17 points and 5 rebounds during the contest. At the losing side the former international guard Stian Mjoes (183-1989) responded with 24 points and 6 assists (made all of his eight free throws) and the former international forward Sjur Dyb Berg (201-1996, college: Alaska-Anch.) produced a double-double by scoring 15 points and 15 rebounds. Four Baerum Basket players scored in double figures.
